clips.title: The story
paras: A sealed summons reaches novice human mages in Northshire Valley, sent by Marshal McBride. Khelden Bremen calls promising spellcasters to Northshire Abbey to begin their arcane tutelage.

Marshal McBride gives the rune-marked letter to an aspiring apprentice who has proved capable by helping him against local vermin. Khelden Bremen, Northshire's resident mage trainer, wrote it. He watches new recruits arriving at the abbey for signs of magical discipline and talent.

Northshire Abbey has long been a sanctuary of the Holy Light, but Stormwind's dangers call for practitioners of every discipline. The letter brings you upstairs to Khelden Bremen. He offers no easy praise. Instead, he warns that mastering arcane power means defying natural limits, earning both profound respect and deep fear from ordinary folk.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. I am Khelden. Is there something I can do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?
I will not lie, friend, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
